hints.github: Create an app under GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps. An identity can be a login name or a numeric ID (a numeric ID stays valid after a rename).
hints.google: Create an OAuth client (Web application) in the Google Cloud Console. An identity can be a verified email address or the sub.
hints.qq: Create a website app on QQ Connect. The openid differs for every app; when a first sign-in is rejected, the page shows the account identifier, which you can add to the allow list.
hints.oidc: Any service that supports OIDC discovery documents (Authentik, Keycloak, Casdoor, etc.). An identity can be a verified email address or the sub.
